versions.changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-quick-search skill.
- Search Douyin (抖音) videos using natural language keywords in Chinese or English.
- Discover trending topics and popular content from Douyin.
- Extract metadata from specific Douyin video URLs.
- No login or API key required; uses web search and page scraping.
- Clear rules for when to trigger searches, show trending, or extract video details.
